preregistration.note: Frozen before any run of this harness; the test split is confirmation only and never picks a ranking.

pareto_rule: Pareto-optimal when no other policy has a lower-or-equal val mean W1, val joint error, and test AUC with at least one strict win. The Pareto set is the result; no policy is promoted to a default.

discriminator_protocol.note: identical protocol for every method and seed

comparison.ci_scope_note: Intervals resample blocks within each of the 4 test sessions and pool them; they are across-session evidence about the recorded sessions, not about unrecorded days.

limitations: single training seed (0); one trained model per cell
validation/test subsamples of 1000 windows, not the full splits
test metrics are confirmation only; rankings are picked on val
the joint score averages the lag ACF error and the correlation error on one scale; both parts are reported separately alongside it
no size effect is claimed from the unmatched historical 221767/480775 variants: different split populations and capacities, historical weights never saved
